articles.title: Claude Reaches GA on Microsoft Foundry: European Enterprises Cannot Deploy It
articles.reason: This article provides critical deployment limitations for Claude models on Azure relevant to EU data residency and compliance, directly impacting enterprise AI architecture decisions for German finance and insurance clients.
articles.summary: Claude models are now generally available on Microsoft Foundry with Azure-native integration, but lack a European data zone, making them non-compliant for production use in EU-regulated sectors like banking and insurance. Anthropic confirms data residency guarantees only for Bedrock and Vertex AI, not Foundry, and European practitioners report the offering is not approved for production. This is a key blocker for deploying Claude in EU enterprise environments, especially for clients with strict compliance requirements.
actionable_insights: Advise clients in finance and insurance that Claude on Foundry is not production-ready in the EU due to data residency gaps.
Prioritize alternative deployment options (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI) for Claude if EU data residency is required.
Monitor for future updates on EU data zones for Foundry before including Claude in regulated client solutions.
